findings.description: F003 declares a pure reconcile(registry, observed_canonical, now, policy) function, while F004 only says it loads observed canonical repos. No proposed feature pins the ledger-to-observed_canonical adapter that reads invocations.jsonl, ignores records without canonical_repo, aggregates count and max last_seen by canonical_repo_key, preserves scrubbed display, and proves command is never read.

F004 mixes two incompatible output expectations: JSON must contain scrubbed display plus counts only with no raw home path, but the tests also require a home-substituted projects add suggestion. If that suggestion appears in --json, C1 and the completion test fail; if it is human-only, the modality boundary is not pinned.

D010 says the durable DontPanic checkout was already registered, but the journey expects the p2a/p2-lock/main fixture to yield one used_unregistered candidate. Correct reconciliation would classify that same canonical repo as registered_active when the D010 registry state is present.

F002 requires refusing any canonical mapping that cannot be confirmed, but the evidence contract does not define deterministic confirmation rules once temp worktrees are gone. Implementers could either guess from scrubbed evidence or over-skip valid historical rows, breaking the required one-time backfill.

F002 acceptance says the local evidence file is excluded or ignored, but the steps do not name the ignore mechanism. Because DONTPANIC_HOME can be overridden during tests or local development, relying on ~/.dontpanic being outside the repo is weaker than the promised commit guard.
